context:
☄️以前是這樣的人嗎？
☄️昨天說的內容就算放到會限裡去講也不奇怪
自從去年下半年開始🌸☄️股價狂噴
至今沒有見頂跡象
為什麼🔮說完  妳們兩個相性很好   應該湊一對  之後
🌸☄️的反應是尷尬+苦笑
🌽則在旁邊笑到合不攏嘴還一直有  中了   中了  的反應
當然是因為🔮講中了啊
🌸☄️兩個是真的有姛的情愫被發現了才有尷尬
🌸☄️苦笑則是因為她們想到的是那接下來該怎麼走呢
能走多遠
未來會發生什麼事
再加上🌸說的有些無奈的話
我無法相信這些都是演的
她們也不是什麼動漫人物
背後是活生生的人
所以我跟好狐一樣
會繼續支持她們的
各方面都是

Was☄️like this before?
What☄️told us last night could’ve been entirely a member’s only stream
The rally of the stock price of🌸☄️since Q3 of last year continues and we have yet to see any sign of a stall in sight
Why did🌸☄️felt awkward and laughed bitterly after🔮told them you two are a super match and should be shipped
While🌽giggled as if she’s won the lottery
Well because🔮spoke the truth
🌸☄️felt awkward because they are in a special relationship
🌸☄️laughed bitterly because they don’t know where this is leading them to
How far can they go
What comes next
Plus🌸was resigned to something lately
I do not believe these were staged
And they are not anime characters
They are real people just like you and me
So I will continue to support them
Just like what the fine fox has been doing
In all the ways I could
